profile: Independent source, geometry and control-flow review
tier: medium is the intended capture tier; actual rendering is not measured here
nativeResolutionMeaning: No renderer or image was evaluated in this review.
blindComparison: No blind comparison was performed. A stranger's preference cannot be inferred from source, normals, UV coordinates or a renderer stub. This bounded review does not satisfy a concept element, pass a product gate, or complete a work unit.
scope: Review of the frozen shadow-bias diagnostic and sign geometry/material changes. PASS applies only to the examined source and geometry after two reproduced/provenance issues were corrected. Real WebKit rendering, image quality, compile success and the diagnostic's repeat-image checks remain to be measured by the existing CI.

target.remoteVerification: Not performed by this read-only reviewer.

resolvedCandidates.originalProblem: The initial cached row called canvas.toDataURL in a separate evaluate after two RAF callbacks and viewport/HUD screenshots. With preserveDrawingBuffer:false, that delayed readback did not establish identity with the earlier production frame.
resolvedCandidates.evidence: The parent already saved a synchronous native PNG immediately after Game.render(0). The old helper unnecessarily read the canvas again after that buffer's guaranteed capture opportunity.
resolvedCandidates.measurementLimit: No blank, stale or corrupted WebKit image was observed in this review. This was a source/provenance defect, not a claimed pixel result.
resolvedCandidates.independentRefutation: The separate refuter confirmed the missing identity guarantee.
resolvedCandidates.correction: The parent now passes cachedFrame:native. The helper reads that exact saved PNG with readFileSync, retaining its path and computing PNG/RGBA hashes. The delayed cached canvas read is removed.
resolvedCandidates.currentDisposition: Resolved on the listed hashes. The cached row and the visual capture use the same file bytes, not two nominally equivalent renders.

resolvedCandidates.originalProblem: The previous _placeSign rotation, -s.rot + PI/2, faced all 15 authored shop signs into their buildings. This was an existing defect retained by the initial material change, not a newly introduced sign-material regression.
resolvedCandidates.procedure: Use buildHollisData, building(), ChunkBuilder and City._placeSign; stub only Canvas2D drawing/measureText. Transform PlaneGeometry's +Z normal and raycast from outside its face. No GPU or rendered text is involved.
resolvedCandidates.independentRefutation: The separate refuter avoided the s.rot-derived expected normal and instead used the actual building-center to sign-center direction. It confirmed inward normals and zero outside hits for the old formula.
resolvedCandidates.correction: The author changed the rotation to s.rot + PI/2.
resolvedCandidates.currentDisposition: Resolved geometrically on the listed City hash. Text readability, lighting and occlusion by other objects remain unmeasured.

shadowVariants.interpretation: The shadow state used by that actual production frame; it is not guaranteed to have been stale.
Original numeric settings with the map rebuilt at the frozen state.
Change only depth bias relative to refreshed; this is a full-color frame, not a raw depth-buffer image.
Change only normalBias relative to depth. Comparing directly to refreshed changes two numeric parameters.
Return to the original numeric settings; decoded RGBA identity with refreshed is the control.

sourceChecks: The parent stops the engine before capture and keeps it stopped until after the diagnostic. The helper rejects a running engine.
All four alternative renders and immediate canvas reads occur synchronously inside one evaluate, without an intervening await. Each requests a shadow-map refresh.
The production render forwards shadowDirty to renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate. The installed Three.js shadow renderer honors that flag when renderer shadow autoUpdate is false.
Frame, simulation time, player position, player hierarchy transforms and camera position/quaternion are compared before and after. Refreshed/repeat decoded RGBA hashes are checked for equality.
The helper finally restores bias and normalBias and renders once more. The parent's finally restores UI display and the prior running state; the outer finally restores settings.

measuredWithRendererStub.procedure: Invoke the actual page.evaluate callback through captureShadowContact with in-memory scene/renderer stubs. Stop before filesystem/image processing. Inspect render/read ordering and inject a failure at the second render.
measuredWithRendererStub.normalPath: Four requested variants render in order, each followed by readback then finish; a fifth render uses the restored original values.
measuredWithRendererStub.exceptionPath: An injected depth-variant render failure still restores bias=-0.0009 and normalBias=0.028 before the finally render.
measuredWithRendererStub.notMeasured: The stub produces no image evidence and cannot establish GPU completion, actual shadow refresh, production pose equality or pixel equality.
measuredWithRendererStub.scratchFailures: Two preliminary versions of the in-memory fixture had syntax errors and produced no results; only the corrected execution is counted.

shadowControlFlow.restorationBoundary: Restoration returns numeric bias settings and a newly refreshed original-parameter frame. It does not restore the old cached shadow texture/history. That distinction is intentional and must remain explicit.
shadowControlFlow.remainingValidation: If the production pose/camera check or exact refreshed/repeat control fails, that view cannot establish a single-variable bias effect. Saved images alone do not override a failed control.

standalone.procedure: Call actual City._standaloneSign with Canvas2D drawing stubbed, update world matrices and raycast both painted faces through two screen-horizontal sample points.
standalone.conclusion: The opposite face rotates its own UV mapping, so U increases left-to-right when viewed from either side. No mirrored-rear mapping defect was found.

materialAndShaderSource.measuredSourceInjection: Calling the actual onBeforeCompile patch on Three.js' standard shader source inserts world-position and height-fog code, and omits the wet term for wet:false.
materialAndShaderSource.scope: Shader source transformation only. No GLSL compilation, lighting result or readability result was measured.

limits: The four shadow views cover stacks, arcade, cinder and ventfield in the parent's eight-spawn capture. They do not cover every pose, interior, camera, quality tier or moving actor.

Game.render(0) does call the production camera and atmosphere updates. Most state uses dt, but camera shake uses performance.now; a stopped engine alone is not proof of identical images. The actual pose and repeat checks are therefore necessary and still pending.
Recorded perfSnapshot percentiles come from the engine's prior sample window; they are not per-variant timings. This review makes no performance claim.
The diagnosis can distinguish a refresh effect from bias changes at these sampled states if its controls pass. It cannot alone prove the best shipping bias values or whole-game shadow quality.
No physical-device result, reference comparison, concept-element satisfaction, release gate pass or final completion is asserted.
reviewerWrites: Only this JSON was written for this bounded task. The reviewer made no product, test, CI, remote or browser changes.
